note: Canada-wide marginal probabilities only -- no joint/correlation structure (lightweight calibration, not Stage 1's full DAG graph-fitting machinery). Derived from real 2021 Census Profile data via 5-year-band interpolation, not hand-set.
source: StatCan Census Profile 2021, Canada, provinces and territories (Open Licence, public)

notes_per_dimension.demo_marital_status: Single/In a relationship/Engaged are NOT independently derivable from StatCan's marital-status table -- Census only reports 'never married, not living common-law' as one undifferentiated bucket. That bucket is split evenly three ways as an explicit placeholder, unlike every other value in this file which is a direct derivation from real counts.
notes_per_dimension.highest_education: MatrAIx's category boundaries don't map exactly onto Canadian credential categories -- No formal/Some college/Postdoc have no real StatCan equivalent (left at 0); Associate's is approximated from completed college/CEGEP + below-bachelor university certificates, the closest real analogue. Reconstructed total still matches StatCan's reported total exactly despite these boundary approximations.
notes_per_dimension.province: Not a dimensions_canada.json catalog entry -- geography breaks the dimension-catalog convention per Step 1.4, so this lives as a plain top-level persona field, not a dimension. Weighted by real 2021 Census population share per province/territory (Open Licence, public), same derive-dont-hand-write approach as everything else in this file. A coarse Track A placeholder -- real point-geocoding is Track B.
